task.description:
Write the test specification for EE-05 (Exclusive Gateway) to `tests/specs/EE-05.md`.

Follow the format used in existing spec files (see tests/specs/ for examples).

Required test cases:

**Happy path — condition routing:**
- TC-EE-05-01: EXCLUSIVE_GATEWAY with two non-default edges; first condition (`variables.amount > 1000`) true → token follows first matching edge.
- TC-EE-05-02: EXCLUSIVE_GATEWAY with two non-default edges; first condition false, second condition (`variables.status == "approved"`) true → token follows second edge (declared order respected).
- TC-EE-05-03: EXCLUSIVE_GATEWAY with only a default edge (`is_default = true`, no condition) → token always follows default edge.
- TC-EE-05-04: EXCLUSIVE_GATEWAY with non-default conditions all false and one default edge → default edge followed (non-defaults exhausted first).

**CEL error handling:**
- TC-EE-05-05: Condition references undefined variable → CEL returns EvalError → treated as `false`; next condition evaluated; default edge followed if available.
- TC-EE-05-06: Condition produces type mismatch (e.g., comparing string to integer) → treated as `false`; iteration continues.

**Error path — no match:**
- TC-EE-05-07: All non-default conditions are false, no default edge defined → `TransitionError.NoMatchingEdge` returned; instance transitions to ERROR per EE-10.

**CEL evaluator unit tests (vendor/cel/cel.zig):**
- TC-EE-05-08: `true` literal → evaluates to true.
- TC-EE-05-09: `false` literal → evaluates to false.
- TC-EE-05-10: `variables.x > 5` with x=10 → true.
- TC-EE-05-11: `variables.x > 5` with x=3 → false.
- TC-EE-05-12: `variables.s == "hello"` with s="hello" → true.
- TC-EE-05-13: `variables.a && variables.b` with a=true, b=false → false.
- TC-EE-05-14: `!variables.flag` with flag=true → false.
- TC-EE-05-15: `variables.missing` (key not in map) → CelError.EvalError.
- TC-EE-05-16: `variables.x > "not a number"` (type mismatch) → CelError.EvalError.
- TC-EE-05-17: Malformed expression `> >` → CelError.ParseError.

For each test case specify:
- Test ID, title, preconditions, steps, expected result, requirement reference (EE-05 AC it covers).
acceptance_criteria: tests/specs/EE-05.md exists with all 17 test cases
Each test case maps to at least one EE-05 acceptance criterion
TC-EE-05-05 and TC-EE-05-06 cover CEL error-as-false behavior

result.summary: Test spec for EE-05 (Exclusive Gateway) written to tests/specs/EE-05.md. All 17 test cases present: TC-EE-05-01 through TC-EE-05-07 cover gateway routing (first-match, declared order, default edge, CEL error-as-false, no-match error path) against the pure transition function; TC-EE-05-08 through TC-EE-05-17 are CEL evaluator unit tests covering boolean literals, numeric/string comparisons, logical AND/NOT, missing variable (EvalError), type mismatch (EvalError), and malformed expression (ParseError). Each test case maps to at least one EE-05 acceptance criterion.
